title: 任务系统设计粗糙且缺乏意义
description: 任务系统存在目标模糊、脚本错误、无奖励、重复单调等问题，任务内容空洞缺乏意义，部分任务无法正常完成，影响任务体验。
evidence: 任務我是做的稀里糊塗（找不到人）
there's no real way to track where any of them are

evidence_items.quote: This is in addition to broken quests, and irrelevant things that just don't make any sense.
evidence_items.description: 任务系统存在故障，例如NPC请求燃料却拒绝 docking，随机任务无目标位置信息
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这还不算那些坏掉的任务，以及那些根本毫无意义、完全说不通的东西。

evidence_items.quote: a handful of non-repeating quests
evidence_items.description: 只有少量非重复任务
evidence_items.quote_zh: 屈指可数的不可重复任务

evidence_items.quote: Quests are just 98% plain text, without barely any choices, no scene art, not even book formatting
evidence_items.description: 任务98%是纯文本，几乎没有选择、场景艺术或书籍格式
evidence_items.quote_zh: 任务98%都是纯文本，几乎没有任何选择，没有场景美术，甚至连书籍排版都没有

evidence_items.quote: Oh, and there is no reward for these, so I'm not really sure what the point is.
evidence_items.description: NPC 随机任务没有奖励
evidence_items.quote_zh: 哦，而且这些任务没有奖励，所以我真的不太确定意义何在。

evidence_items.quote: 99% of the apparent quests are totally sterile and literally lacking even distinct flavor text
evidence_items.description: 任务缺乏独特风味文本，显得枯燥
evidence_items.quote_zh: 99%的表面任务都完全死气沉沉，甚至字面上连独特的风味文本都没有

evidence_items.quote: theres gigs in the game that simply cannot be completed because there are only a handful of actual locations in the game.
evidence_items.description: 部分任务因游戏地点太少而无法完成
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏里有些任务根本无法完成，因为游戏里实际上只有寥寥几个地点。

evidence_items.quote: Having a quest where a stranger asked me to "rough somebody up" is silly.
evidence_items.description: 有任务让陌生人要求‘揍某人一顿’，很傻
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有个任务是一个陌生人让我去“揍某人一顿”，这太蠢了。

evidence_items.quote: missions full of scripting errors and vague, blink-and-you'll-miss objectives
evidence_items.description: 任务充满脚本错误和模糊目标
evidence_items.quote_zh: 充斥着脚本错误和模糊不清、眨眼就会错过的目标的任务

evidence_items.quote: Broken quests (people on Steam and Discord literally recommend not engaging with them).
evidence_items.description: 任务损坏，玩家建议不要做任务
evidence_items.quote_zh: 任务损坏（Steam和Discord上的人真的建议不要碰它们）。

evidence_items.quote: We can do a whole [b]TWO[/b] (!) types of quests
evidence_items.description: 只有两种任务类型，内容极度匮乏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我们可以做整整[b]两[/b]（！）种任务

evidence_items.quote: you'll regularly be contacted by npcs to do various tasks which all tend to be either to bring them something or to talk to another npc with just one or two prompts, these all also have very short introduction and completion texts, and they make you wonder why you even did them to begin with
evidence_items.description: 任务内容重复且简短，缺乏意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你会经常被NPC联系去做各种任务，而这些任务往往要么是给他们带点东西，要么是跟另一个NPC说话，只有一两个提示，这些任务的介绍和完成文本也都非常短，让你不禁怀疑自己当初为什么要做它们

evidence_items.quote: I wish there was more incentive to do the quests beyond making enough money for your first license
evidence_items.description: 任务除了赚取第一张执照的钱外缺乏动力
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我希望除了赚够钱买第一张执照之外，做任务能有更多激励

evidence_items.quote: there's no real way to track where any of them are
evidence_items.description: 任务无法追踪位置，且多数指向当前无法到达的地点
evidence_items.quote_zh: 根本没有真正的办法追踪它们中的任何一个在哪里

evidence_items.quote: the occasional detective job (don't get too excited, it's very basic)
evidence_items.description: 侦探任务内容非常基础
evidence_items.quote_zh: 偶尔的侦探工作（别太兴奋，它非常基础）

evidence_items.quote: 任務我是做的稀里糊塗（找不到人）
evidence_items.description: 任务指引不清，找不到人
evidence_items.quote_zh: 任務我是做的稀里糊塗（找不到人）

evidence_items.quote: there aren't many jobs yet, aside from scavenging
evidence_items.description: 除了拾荒外，游戏中的任务数量很少
evidence_items.quote_zh: 目前还没有很多工作，除了拾荒之外

evidence_items.quote: 做些没有意义的跑腿任务
evidence_items.description: 任务没有意义，只是跑腿
evidence_items.quote_zh: 做些没有意义的跑腿任务

evidence_items.quote: Quests are random generated pointless nonsence, and in latest version you are bombarded by them
evidence_items.description: 任务随机生成且无意义，最新版本中大量出现
evidence_items.quote_zh: 任务是随机生成的毫无意义的废话，而在最新版本中你被它们狂轰滥炸

player_themes.title: NPC 随机任务没有奖励

evidence_items.quote: Oh, and there is no reward for these, so I'm not really sure what the point is.
evidence_items.description: NPC 随机任务没有奖励
evidence_items.quote_zh: 哦，而且这些任务没有奖励，所以我真的不太确定意义何在。
